name: shop-platform
description: Professional e-commerce platform — catalog, orders, payments, courier, admin

scripts.//build: shared আগে — api আর web দুটোই ওর dist থেকে টাইপ পড়ে, তাই এটা বাদ দিলে fresh clone-এ build ভাঙে
scripts.build: npm run build -w @shop/shared && npm run build -w @shop/api && npm run build -w @shop/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @shop/shared && npm run test -w @shop/api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @shop/shared && npm run lint -w @shop/api && npm run lint -w @shop/web
